verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a dedicated Privacy and Data Protection practice with over 130 lawyers, 25 years' experience and former DPA members (Irish DPC, CNIL). It backs this with a published GDPR compliance guide and a free SCC Generator Tool for EU-mandated data transfer agreements, which covers GDPR counselling directly. Missing for 10: independent or third-party corroboration of the practice, evidence of cybersecurity-specific counsel, and explicit mention of CCPA/DPDP or other non-EU regimes.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice
